sources.title: HKU Stephen Hui Geological Museum: Plants in the dinosaur world, Ginkgo yimaensis CH105
sources.notes: Primary museum specimen record. Label Ginkgo yimaensis Zhou et Zhang, Middle Jurassic China, displayed size13cm. Original defining paper not acquired. Photograph shows one long petiole and deeply divided lobed lamina, not a branch or modern biloba fan. Specimen-based organ interpretation, not an exact cast.

sources.actual_reference_pixels_inspected: Personally inspected museum full page and original CH105 photograph before concept; six conspicuous elongate lobes/fan divisions and a long single petiole, no evidence of short shoot.
